item.text:
**Verdict**
Mixed, leaning no. Trọng’s 2024 record does show real institution-building in welfare delivery and administrative standards: codified social insurance, a formal social-work profession, expanded child-protection staffing, and updated audit standards. But the strongest counterevidence is that these institutions remained nested in a one-party system with no independent courts, unions, or civil society, and the anti-graft drive still produced administrative disruption. Because his duties were transferred on July 18, 2024, late-year effects are only partly attributable to him personally.

**Evidence**
- [Law on Social Insurance No. 41/2024/QH15](https://xaydungchinhsach.chinhphu.vn/toan-van-luat-so-41-2024-qh15-bao-hiem-xa-hoi-119240723163650489.htm); National Assembly / Chính phủ Việt Nam mirror; 2024-07-26, passed 2024-06-29; creates a state-funded social retirement allowance and turns key old-age support into statutory entitlement rather than discretionary patronage. IDs: `6B.9`, `6B.8`, `6B.7`.
- [Decree 110/2024/ND-CP on social work](https://thuvienphapluat.vn/van-ban/EN/Van-hoa-Xa-hoi/Decree-110-2024-ND-CP-social-work/627226/tieng-anh.aspx?tab=0); Government of Vietnam via Thư Viện Pháp Luật mirror; 2024-08-30; establishes a licensing and qualification regime for social-work practitioners, with certification required by 2027, which is a durable profession-building move. IDs: `6B.9`, `6B.8`.
- [UNICEF applauds Viet Nam’s progress establishment social work and counseling](https://www.unicef.org/vietnam/press-releases/unicef-applauds-viet-nams-progress-establishment-social-work-and-counseling); UNICEF Viet Nam; 2024; says the government created defined social-worker posts in health facilities and school-counselor posts in schools, plus training for university-trained workers. IDs: `6B.9`, `6B.8`.
- [Building a Social Protection System that Improves Gender Equality](https://www.unicef.org/vietnam/stories/building-social-protection-system-improves-gender-equality); UNICEF Viet Nam; 2024-07-11; describes monthly government cash assistance reaching a family with a disabled child and being used for food and schooling, showing a real delivery system rather than one-off charity. IDs: `6B.9`, `6B.8`, `6B.7`.
- [Audit standards of the State Audit Office of Viet Nam 2024](https://www.sav.gov.vn/SMPT_Publishing_UC/TinTuc/PrintTL.aspx?ItemID=261&idb=11&l=%2Fen%2Ftintuc%2FLists%2FNews); State Audit Office of Viet Nam; 2024; updates the audit framework with 43 standards across financial, compliance, and performance audits, strengthening a bureaucratic institution that can outlast one leader, though still inside the party-state. IDs: `6B.9`, `6B.7`.
- [Vietnam: Freedom in the World 2024 Country Report](https://freedomhouse.org/country/vietnam/freedom-world/2024); Freedom House; 2024; says Vietnam is a one-party state with tightly controlled elections, restricted civil society, and no meaningful independent courts, so the surviving institutions are not autonomous. IDs: `6B.9`, `6B.8`, `6B.7`.
- [World Report 2024: Vietnam](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/vietnam); Human Rights Watch; 2024; says independent unions, political parties, and press are prohibited and the judiciary is subordinate to the CPV, which is strong counterevidence to durable independent institutions. IDs: `6B.9`, `6B.8`, `6B.7`.
- [Viet Nam’s economy poised for gradual recovery](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/04/23/viet-nam-s-economy-poised-for-gradual-recovery-world-bank-report-finds); World Bank; 2024-04-23; says stronger social assistance, better higher-education access, and more support for ethnic minorities and disadvantaged students were still needed, showing the institutional project remained incomplete. IDs: `6B.9`, `6B.8`.
- [Vietnam labor minister rebuked for mismanagement](https://e.vnexpress.net/news/news/crime/vietnam-labor-minister-rebuked-for-mismanagement-4736499.html); VnExpress International / Reuters; 2024-04-19; shows weak oversight in a ministry tied to vocational training and social resources, which undercuts claims of a fully professional service state. IDs: `6B.9`, `6B.8`, `6B.7`.
- [Exclusive: Vietnam forfeits billions of dollars in foreign aid amid anti-graft freeze, document says](https://theprint.in/world/exclusive-vietnam-forfeits-billions-of-dollars-in-foreign-aid-amid-anti-graft-freeze-document-says/2088974/); Reuters via ThePrint; 2024-05-17; reports administrative paralysis, delayed approvals, and lost aid from the anti-graft campaign, showing institutional brittleness rather than clear durability. IDs: `6B.9`, `6B.7`.

**Search Gap**
I did not find evidence that Trọng built genuinely independent unions, courts, or civic oversight bodies in 2024. The durable institutions I found are mostly state-run entitlements, professional rules, and audit frameworks, not autonomous institutions clearly insulated from party control.
